verdict.rationale: Vercel's own Workflows product runs multi-step logic as durable background code that retries failed steps, waits for external events, and resumes across crashes. eve lets you build durable backend AI agents that run on Vercel (beta), so the platform does host autonomous background automation. However, automations must be written as code with the SDK or framework, and there is no evidence of recurring schedules (cron-style triggers) for these automations; schedule-based ISR page regeneration is a different capability and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented recurring/scheduled triggers (cron) for background jobs, no-code automation setup, independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background

citations.quote: Vercel Workflows runs multi-step logic as durable code that can retry failed steps, wait for external events, and resume across crashes and deployments.
Build durable, observable applications and AI agents with the Workflow SDK on a fully managed platform.
Build durable backend AI agents with eve, an open-source, filesystem-first framework. Agent files compile into an app that runs locally or on Vercel.
